The GIT 2025 site is built and checked. Home, Program, Registration Fee, and Contact are plain PHP pages. Program and fees are read from `data/program.json` and `data/fees.json` on every request, and contact messages are stored as JSON lines under `data/`.

`php -S 127.0.0.1:8080 -t public` returned 200 for all four pages. An empty POST to `/contact` kept the form and showed field errors. A valid POST showed "Thank you, your message has been sent." followed by the subject. `GET /contact/submissions.json` returned `[]` before that message and the stored list afterward. An unknown address returned 404, and POST `/program` returned 405. At 375 px the four navigation links stay visible.

The specification checklist had no unchecked items. One convergence pass found nothing left to build. The commits are on `exp/2026-10-09-gitcon-v1-speckit-01`. The draft pull request against main is https://github.com/Awannaphasch2016/sdd-gitcon-impl/pull/1. The pull request tool opened it from the workspace branch that holds the same commits.
